company.shortDescription: DENTA operates a digital platform for dental education, professional networking, recruitment, and practice management.
company.description: DENTA operates a digital platform for dental professionals, students, and practitioners. It provides revision materials for internat and CSCT examinations, including clinical cases and study sheets. Its social networking module supports the exchange of dental cases and professional discussions. DENTA also provides recruitment listings and a marketplace for dental equipment. Practice management resources cover cabinet creation, legal structures, staffing, premises, regulatory requirements, and patient development. The platform combines educational, networking, recruitment, marketplace, and practice-management functions for the dental sector.
